Resolves #19297

The two large-over-small arms of `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL` now assert the converted drag's current contract (#19254):
- the target proxy is the tab header the hand grabbed: its label, and its extent measured at the press;
- the vessel parks clear of the target (`lastVesselParkReceipt` `cleared` and `parked`).

They no longer compare the proxy to the source viewport, a contract #19254 retired. Every local NL run on `dev` has listed these two as known reds since #19309 gave headless Chrome its 1920×1080 screen. The change is test code only.

Evidence: L3 local (Brain-gated NL specs, which CI never runs) → L3 required (AC-1..3). No residual.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the shared baseline jobs run on this PR.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — one spec's stale expectation re-aimed to the shipped contract, no source change.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
| :--- | :--- |
| AC-1 | Outside CI (NL battery, the 1920×1080 screen from `BASE_LAUNCH_ARGS`): `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL.spec.mjs` "large-over-small: one local proxy plus readable target choices" and "large-over-small: pointer release transfers one pane with undo and redo" pass; the file is 4/4 at 8f76d51. Red first on the same base (`dev` 2375643, the old expectation): both failed at "target proxy width follows the live source viewport", with \|Δ\| = 712 px. |
| AC-2 | The shared arm body asserts three things. The proxy carries the grabbed tab's label. Its width and height equal the grabbed header button's within 1 px (`sourceGesture.hit.rendererBox`). `lastVesselParkReceipt` matches `{cleared: true, parked: true}`. The rendered target zones were already asserted (visible indicators, five readable target choices, the preview) and are unchanged. |
| AC-3 | Outside CI: with `--screen-info` filtered out of the launch args (headless Chrome's 800×600 screen, through an untracked config override), both arms skip and the other two pass. The skip is untouched. |

## Deltas from ticket
- **The extent's witness is the grabbed button**, measured by the gesture driver at the press, rather than the transition record's `proxyRect`. Both measured 48×32 on this run. The record is the product's own claim; the button is what the hand held.
- **A label check joins the extent check:** a proxy of the right size but the wrong content fails.

## Test Evidence
- **NL battery, local** (`NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` at my Brain clone, private bridge port 18081):
  - 4/4 at 8f76d51 with the 1920×1080 screen;
  - 2 passed and 2 skipped at 800 px;
  - 2 failed and 2 passed at `dev` 2375643 before the change.
